# Tommy Jackett

> Tommy Jackett is a Melbourne filmmaker and storyteller. He co-hosts and co-wrote the documentary In Guns We Trust (2026), and runs VIDPOD, a video production company.

In Guns We Trust (2026) is a 76 minute feature documentary, free on YouTube worldwide from Friday 23 October 2026, 11am AEDT (Thursday 22 October, 8pm US Eastern). Hosted by Tommy Jackett and Josh Janssen. Story by Josh Janssen, Naysan Naraqi and Tommy Jackett. Directed by Josh Janssen. Made by 2A Film, Full Stack Films and Rethink Films. The film takes no side on guns.

## On this site

## Originals
- [The Jackett Ranch](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v-t6ll80OF8): My family bought a block of land in America in the '70s. Nobody had been to see it, so I went. Now we're giving it away.
- [DJ Daka](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8XlNCE0Oyhw): My son wanted to be a DJ, so I backed him. He made a song for his favourite DJ, Will Sparks. Next minute, we're meeting him. Now he's got his own decks and he's playing sets.
- [The Daily Talk Show](https://www.thedailytalkshow.com): More than 1,000 episodes with my best mate, Josh.
- [The 7-Eleven Coffee Rabbit Hole](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WRFVNZgnEEM): The $3 cup fits inside the $2 cup. So I kept digging.
- [The O Bike Rabbit Hole](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j5e-fhUCxmk): Melbourne was full of abandoned oBikes, so I went fishing for them in the Yarra. Then it got bigger.
